mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_conversation (id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, default_slot, title, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{sessionId}, #{title}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_chat_conversation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND default_slot = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
